svg.title: Contribution city
svg.desc: Contribution city: isometric view of 1,090 contributions from 2025-11-10 to 2026-11-10 across 102 active days. Each tile is one day; taller tiles mean more contributions relative to the busiest day (54). GitHub contribution calendar: all activity, including repositories not featured here. One tile per day, height = relative daily contributions. An activity signal, not a quality measure.
